biography.plain_text: Nick DiCello is an American businessman and founder of Ohio State Waterproofing, a basement waterproofing and foundation repair company. An Ohio University business graduate, he established the venture in 1978 after his employer closed, beginning with three employees. He remains chief executive of the family business, which expanded through EverDry franchises.

long_biography.plain_text:
Waterproofing entrepreneur Nick DiCello expected employees to bring proposed solutions to meetings, then gave them authority to carry out an agreed plan. When a project missed its goal, he asked what they had learned and how they would revise their approach. His company also developed basement ventilation to address odours, extending its work beyond stopping water entry.

His support for Beech Brook involved direct participation in its holiday programme for foster children. Over more than twenty-five years, DiCello personally shopped for presents, wrapped them and delivered them to the children.
